source: GB 50017-2017 limit state design of steel members: f = fy / γR (γR taken 1.164 for every grade, see sources), the width-thickness classes S1-S5 (3.5.1) in εk = √(235/fy), the stability coefficient φ of the section classes a-d (7.2.1, Appendix D), the plasticity factor γx 1.05 (6.1.2), shear fv = f/√3 (6.1.3), tension 0.7 fu on the net section (7.1.1), the linear section and member checks (8.1, 8.2; conservative forms); lateral-torsional buckling by the parent method's χLT on Mcr in place of φb (see VERIFY); connections and the seismic steel rules from the parent pack (named so)

clauses.lateralTorsional: 6.2 (χLT of the parent method in place of φb)

sources.partialFactors: GB 50017-2017 Table 4.4.1: f of Q355 at t <= 16 mm is 305 MPa: γR = 355/305 = 1.164 taken for every grade (SAEngine practice: Q235 gives 202 in place of 215 MPa, on the safe side); the bolt and weld factors are not GB values (connections are the parent's)
sources.designStrength: GB/T 700 and GB/T 1591-2018: the yield strength by thickness (Q235, Q355, Q390, Q420), divided by γR
sources.compression.perry: GB 50017-2017 Appendix D (D.0.5): φ = 1 - α1 λn² (λn <= 0.215), else the Perry form with α2, α3 of the classes a, b, c, d (c and d with their second pair from λn 1.05)
sources.compression.rolledI: GB 50017-2017 Table 7.2.1-1: rolled I and H with b/h <= 0.8 x a, y b; b/h > 0.8 x b, y c; t >= 80 mm x c, y d (Table 7.2.1-2)
sources.compression.families: GB 50017-2017 Table 7.2.1-1: class b taken for channels, tees, angles, hollow and solid sections (hot-finished tubes are class a: on the safe side)
sources.flexure.elasticCap: GB 50017-2017 6.1.2: γx = 1.05 (S1-S3 I sections), 1.0 for S4 (SAEngine's semi-compact)
sources.flexure.alphaLT: Not GB values: χLT of the curves b (rolled) and c (welded) on λLT = √(W fy / Mcr), λLT0 0.4, in place of φb of GB 50017 6.2.2 and Appendix C (SAEngine practice, on the safe side for λLT > 0.6)
sources.tension.ruptureShare: GB 50017-2017 7.1.1: N/An <= 0.7 fu (0.7 × γR in the method's An fu / γm1)
sources.tension.angleAlpha: GB 50017-2017 7.1.3: single angles connected by one leg, efficiency 0.85
sources.shear.lambdaLimits: GB 50017-2017 6.3.3: τcr = fv up to λn,s 0.8, [1 - 0.59 (λn,s - 0.8)] fv to 1.2, 1.1 fv/λn,s² beyond (SAEngine's method takes 1.0/λ² there, on the safe side)
sources.slenderness: GB 50017-2017 Table 7.4.6 (main compression members 150) and Table 7.4.7 (tension members 300, static loads)
sources.classification: GB 50017-2017 Table 3.5.1: S1 / S3 / S4 limits in SAEngine's plastic / compact / semi-compact (S3 takes γx 1.05, S4 the elastic moment, S5 slender); the web limits at α0 = 2 (bending), axial by the factors k of (1 + k r)
